The initial mass gain from the birth weight to the weaning stage is substantial, though the pup remains well below the ultimate adult dimensions achieved later in life. Early growth trajectories in this species are thus tightly linked to the successful provisioning efforts of the lactating female.

Comparisons with congeneric species suggest that these mass values are consistent with the general morphometric profile of the leaf-nosed bat lineage.
